reasons.text: The label photo is the same image as a photo on another claim in the program, so the claim is flagged for review under the duplicate-photo rule.
The label is legible and shows model 200LX, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The typed serial QQ19420553 falls outside the recalled serial ranges, which would on its own support a denial.
The purchase date of 2018-09-25 is inside the sale window, and no receipt is required for this claim.
